facts.fact: Libya News Agency reports the Ministry of Labour and Rehabilitation held a several-day workshop on basic computer skills for its staff in Sirte, closing on 26 August 2025 with certificates.

facts.fact: Libya Update, citing LANA, reports the Ministry of Civil Service launched a one-week, ten-hour computer-applications course for government employees in Benghazi on 14 September 2025, the first of a series on electronic archiving.

facts.fact: EU4Skills reports a 10 May 2025 workshop of the Libyan Digital Lab, with Expertise France, on adapting France's Pix digital-skills platform for Libyan students, teachers and public sector employees, ending with follow-up plans.
